entities.name: Oriel Kjeldos
entities.description: A shaman, leader of Clan Emerald of Storgard who led a band away from the doomed citadel and is considered a founder of Kjeldor.

entities.name: Jason Carthalion
entities.description: A young ward taken in by Oriel after his parents died.

entities.name: Clan Emerald
entities.description: Clan of Storgard led by Oriel.

entities.name: Clan Pearl
entities.description: Clan of Storgard whose members left with Oriel.

entities.name: Arimaya
entities.description: Clan Onyx leader who called Oriel her Emerald sister.

events.summary: Oriel takes in the young Jason Carthalion as her ward after the death of his parents.
events.quote: She took in a young Jason Carthalion as her ward after the death of his parents.

events.summary: Before the Fall of Storgard, Oriel leads a band from Clan Pearl and Clan Emerald away from the citadel.
events.quote: she led a large band of others, including Jason, Hurn , Mariska , and 48 other members of Clan Pearl and Clan Emerald, away from the doomed citadel

events.summary: Oriel dies on the journey from Storgard.
events.quote: Though she eventually died on the journey from Storgard

relations.quote: Oriel was the leader of Clan Emerald of Storgard by 2434 AR .
She took in a young Jason Carthalion as her ward
